title: Impact of Home-Based Learning on Students' Learning and Development
what_it_is: Impact of Home-Based Learning on Students' Learning and Development

sections.label: MOE keeping schools safe
sections.summary: MOE keeps schools safe so they can stay open, as home-based learning cannot fully replace school-based learning and affects students' development and well-being.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education's (MOE's) approach has been to keep schools safe so that they can remain open as far as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We recognise that home-based learning (HBL) cannot be a full substitute for the school-based learning experience.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: On a prolonged basis, it comes at a cost not just to students' learning but also their socio-emotional development and mental well-being.

sections.label: Primary schools home-based learning
sections.summary: All Primary schools were placed on home-based learning from 27 September to 6 October, extended by a day to 7 October, covering two weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: To reduce the possible disruption to the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) cohort and as an additional precautionary measure for Primary schools, we had placed all our Primary schools on HBL from 27 September to 6 October.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Subsequently, when the national posture tightened, this was extended by a day to include 7 October, effectively covering Term 4, Week 3 to 4, or two weeks, given that Children's Day on 8 October is already a school holiday.

sections.label: Extra precautions for Primary schools
sections.summary: Most primary school kids are not vaccinated, so extra precautions are taken; MOE will announce later this week whether to extend HBL for Primary schools.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The main difference being that most of our primary school kids, less half of the Primary 6 cohorts, are not vaccinated yet, which is why we have taken extra precautions for our Primary schools.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, the kind of anxiety that the students or their families may face is quite different.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We will do what is necessary to make sure that the ongoing "N" and the upcoming "O" and "A" Level examinations can continue to be conducted safely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: On the first question as to whether we will extend HBL for the Primary schools, MOE will be making an announcement later this week.
